definitions.gloss: to make an effort; to try hard; to endeavor
definitions.explanation: To exert oneself toward a goal, typically implying sustained, diligent effort rather than a single attempt.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{努力|どりょく}している。
examples.english: I'm making an effort every day.

examples.japanese: {合格|ごうかく}するために{一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい}{努力|どりょく}した。
examples.english: I tried my hardest to pass the exam.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{長年|ながねん}{努力|どりょく}を{重|かさ}ねて、ついに{夢|ゆめ}を{実現|じつげん}させた。
examples.english: After years of accumulated effort, he finally realized his dream.

notes:
Describes sustained, diligent effort toward a goal. Unlike {頑張|がんば}る, which emphasizes perseverance and fighting spirit, {努力|どりょく}する focuses on the disciplined, steady accumulation of effort over time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {努力|どりょく}を{続|つづ}ける: to continue making efforts
- {努力|どりょく}を{重|かさ}ねる: to accumulate efforts
- {努力|どりょく}が{実|みの}る: efforts bear fruit
- {努力|どりょく}が{足|た}りない: not enough effort
- {最大限|さいだいげん}の{努力|どりょく}: maximum effort

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頑張|がんば}る: to persevere — more colloquial and emphasizes fighting spirit
- {励|はげ}む: to work hard at — focuses on devotion to a specific activity
- {精進|しょうじん}する: to devote oneself — more formal, often implies self-improvement
